content: संजयः .²1 Conquest, victory. .²2 A kind of military array. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the charioteer of king Dhṛtarāṣṭra. He tried to bring about a peaceful settlement of the dispute between the Kauravas and Pāṇḍavas, but failed. It was he who narrated the events of the great Bhāratī war to the blind king Dhṛtarāṣṭra; <ab>cf.</ab> धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः . मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत संजय .. <ls>Bg. 1. 1</ls>.
